name: houdini_hosts
description: List the Houdinis offered to OpenCode on this computer (Houdini with OpenCode Link installed offers itself when it starts): label, document, Houdini version, and whether this conversation or another one is attached to each (attached_to: the one this conversation acts on), with the installed part's state. attach: attach one (its offerID) to this conversation, which asks permission; detach: release this conversation's Houdini. With one offered Houdini that no conversation uses, the first Houdini tool call attaches it.
